name: gh-mcp-demo
description: Demo plugins for the GitHub and Atlassian (Bitbucket) MCP servers and session_mcp.

plugins.name: pr-session
plugins.description: Send session details to session_mcp: the PR URL after the GitHub MCP server creates a pull request or the Atlassian MCP server creates a Bitbucket pull request, and the new title after /rename. Also creates a Jira work item, through the Atlassian MCP server, for each GitHub pull request.
